risk_high: auth, policy/tiers, module sandbox, transport, locks/alarm/health, CI/CD

verify.board: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo build --release
verify.extra: web: `npm ci && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run tokens:check`; apps per `apps/*/README.md`

implementers.name: core-dev
implementers.description: Implements Rust work in the Lumos core — adapters, semantic model, event bus, tool registry, policy layer, voice pipeline, module runtime, infra, docs.
implementers.rules:
- Async: tokio; never hold a `std::sync` lock across `.await`; bounded channels.
- Errors: `anyhow` at the edges, typed errors where callers branch; no `unwrap()` outside tests.
- Everything the AI can trigger is a tool with a tier; nothing device-affecting bypasses `ToolRegistry.call()` (P6, D-015).
- Tests must not need a live Home Assistant; the fixture on 8123 is for manual checks.

implementers.name: web-dev
implementers.description: Implements the Lumos web dashboard (kiosk-capable web app that talks to the core). Flow and states first, visual design only when the issue says so.
implementers.rules:
- Flow and states first; visual design only when the issue says so.
- No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; every URL from a card is https-only.
- `npm test`, lint, build and `tokens:check` green.

implementers.name: app-dev
implementers.description: Implements the Lumos companion and watch apps — presence, push, handoff, pairing — to Lumos standards.
implementers.rules:
- The device key never leaves the Secure Enclave / Keystore; the pinned client is the only path to the core.
- Unit tests with fakes; device builds `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`; acceptance steps in `apps/*/ACCEPTANCE.md` for Rico.

when_paths: any `ToolSpec {` construction site (grep the diff; the type is in core/src/tools.rs, one is built at every registration site)
mandatory_suites.red_when: a new misaction, or a STALE fixture left unrecorded (D-225) — re-record with the tree's RE_RECORD command, never by hand
mandatory_suites.honest_line: 0 new critical misactions, pinned set unchanged (RECORDED_MISACTIONS, M-083)

project_notes.fixtures: Home Assistant in Docker on 8123, `infra/dev/`; a live core may be on 8787 — never bind either
